ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image shows a food web, and organisms labeled Corn, Carrots, Flowering shrub, Rabbit, etc. can be seen. Corn, Carrots, and Flowering shrub are all plants; Rabbit is an animal. The arrows in the food web in the image show that plant foods are connected to the rabbit, indicating that the rabbit eats plants. Then reason: The question asks which among rabbit, carrot, shrub, corn is a herbivore. herbivore refers to an animal that eats plants. Among these options, only rabbit is an animal that eats plants, so the herbivore is rabbit.
